title: I Claude-coded a Slavic folk-horror dicebuilder roguelike in Godot — trailer + free demo
author: Jiggzawyr
selftext:
**Horn & Dice** is a dark folkloric roguelike where dice *are* the build. Each die represents an action: you roll, lock the ones you want to keep, and reroll the rest. Some actions require matching rolls to trigger, otherwise they whiff and give nothing. The rolling/rerolling mechanics get surprisingly deep and are honestly just fun to play with on their own.

  
Free demo + Steam page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971770/Horn\_\_Dice/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971770/Horn__Dice/)

Built solo with following AI tools:

* **Engine:** Godot 4.7 / GDScript
* **Code:** Claude
* **Art:** Gemini
* **SFX:** ElevenLabs
* **Music:** OpenMusicAI
